records.groupTitle: Proportion Of Residents Aged 15 - 24 Years Who Are Unemployed Or Outside The Labour Force Due To Reasons Other Than Education Or Training By Sex
records.title: Proportion Of Residents Aged 15 - 24 Years Who Are Unemployed Or Outside The Labour Force Due To Reasons Other Than Education Or Training By Sex, Annual
records.footnote: Data pertain to the resident population (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) who are unemployed or outside the labour force due to reasons other than education or training. Annual proportions are based on the simple averages of the quarterly numbers of all resident youths and those youths who are unemployed or outside the labour force due to reasons other than education or training. Data are used for SDG 8.6.1 'Proportion of youth (aged 15 24 years) not in education, employment or training'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 8.6.1.
